items.title: YouTuber爆料称R星证实：有粉丝为蹲点新预告，竟测量其工作室园区周边的氧气含量

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/xfnQwObubrBvCCB.jpg
意大利 YouTuber Mike ShowSha 在 Rockstar 举办大型 GTA6 Netflix 展示会之前访问了该公司。开发人员告诉他，心急如焚的粉丝们为了预测新预告片的发布，竟然在测量他们园区周围的含氧量。

早在 6 月，一名 GTA 超级粉丝就因为据称测量 Rockstar North 园区周围的含氧量而走红。他们的想法是，如果氧气消耗量增加，说明现场有更多员工，这意味着团队正在加班加点工作或准备发布重大公告。
这位粉丝还在园区外安装了声学音频设备，甚至在附近露营，监测进出员工的流量，拼命想要评估游戏的开发进度。
更新：他开始监测 Rockstar North 周围的氧气，并认为“预告片 3”即将到来。他注意到下午 5 点后氧气水平下降到约 20.3% 和 20.04%，这表明正常工作时间后该地区的氧气消耗量有所增加。
YouTuber Mike ShowSha 是受邀前往 Rockstar 办公室在 Netflix 深度展示之前近距离了解游戏的幸运创作者之一。他声称员工们向他证实，确实有超级粉丝在测量他们工作场所的含氧量。
“伙计们，我被告知了一些奇怪的事情，”这位 YouTuber 在 8 月 28 日的一段视频中说道。“比如，有人在测量氧气水平——我不知道他们是怎么做到的，但这是 Rockstar 的人告诉我的，所以我倾向于相信他们。因为如果有迹象表明工作室里有更多人，就意味着开发力度加大了，因此大事即将发生。这简直太疯狂了。”
网友对这段轶事的反应既觉得好笑又感到不安，有人在 X 上开玩笑说：“难怪他们预告片的开头是‘哟，瘾君子们！’”
“对预告片痴迷到这种程度简直是疯了，”另一位网友表示。
“兄弟，谁会这么想？”还有人问。“我的意思是，这确实很聪明，但想想看，如果人们真的想要某样东西，他们会做出什么样的事情。”
GTA6 终于将于 2026 年 11 月 19 日发售，届时它将正式终结“我们在 GTA6 之前等到了 [某物]”的梗。我们可以从 Netflix 的扩展展示会以及对 Rockstar 办公室的访问中看到很多期待的内容，我们在那里了解到了关于游戏的 69 个新细节——包括如果你不想主动参与 Jason 和 Lucia 的感情机制，你也可以不这样做。
虽然这款游戏的期待值达到了历史最高点，但并不是每个人都对其破纪录的发售感到兴奋。一些配偶在社交媒体上声称，由于 Jason 和 Lucia 之间的关系，玩这款游戏实际上等同于“出轨”。我们不知道哪种行为更疯狂——是这个，还是粉丝字面上在 Rockstar 园区外露营测量氧气水平。

《进击的巨人》第二季包含全剧最经典的场景之一。在这一幕中，艾伦在经历了一系列漫长而艰苦的事件后，与调查兵团的同伴莱纳和胡佛交谈。这一特定时刻揭示了两名士兵的重大背叛，他们承认自己就是多年前突破城墙的智慧巨人，导致了无数人的死亡以及艾伦母亲的悲剧。
如果你是日语原声观众，你一定对梶裕贵对那句“你们这些叛徒！”的出色演绎非常熟悉；但 Bryce Papenbrook 在这里的表现也极具冲击力。事实上，为了表现艾伦对莱纳和胡佛背叛的悲痛，他非常投入，甚至通过让下巴脱臼的方式来强迫自己感受真实的身体疼痛。
Papenbrook 在今年 8 月的 Anime NYC 专题讨论会上透露了这一令人震惊的消息，这让同台的配音演员 Cristina Vee 感到非常困惑。
“在那一刻，他比以往任何时候都更加疯狂。所以在那次录音之前，我真的让自己的下巴脱臼了，因为我希望那种痛苦能传达出来，”他解释道。
“你是什么意思——生理上的脱臼？故意的？”Vee 问道，显然被震惊了。
“是的，”Papenbrook 回答道。“就像，生理上把我的下巴推错位，把疼痛强加到感觉中，因为那是艾伦在那一刻的感受。对于艾伦这个角色，我真的很想感受他的所感，所以在第一季他咬自己的手时，我也狠狠地咬了自己的手，甚至留下了淤青。”
粉丝们对 Papenbrook 的敬业精神感到既震惊又佩服，一位用户在社交平台上写道：“对配音的攻击实在是太刻意了，怎么会有人看到这些还说它不好呢？”
“他真的不必做到这种地步，但我仍然喜欢演员全身心投入角色的样子，”另一位粉丝说。
“在你问之前，是的，就是那么严肃，”还有人开玩笑说。（我必须同意——虽然我更喜欢日语原版动画，但这个特定场景确实需要 Papenbrook 表现出极其强烈的情感，而他在这里完美地做到了。）
虽然《进击的巨人》动画已经完结，但这系列深受喜爱的作品还将有更多内容，游戏 Attack on Titan 3 定于 2026 年 12 月 3 日发售，玩家可以创建自己的角色，体验动画最后一季的剧情。

堡垒之夜 和 Focus Features 周三宣布，由安德鲁·加菲尔德主演的新电影《起义》（The Uprising）现已作为 堡垒之夜 的自定义体验上线，领先于由保罗·格林格拉斯执导的电影在 9 月 10 日的院线公映。
即便对于有着悠久流行文化联动历史（包括《星球大战》、漫威、DC、乐高、巫师4、《哥斯拉大战金刚》、《怪奇物语》、《疾速追杀》以及《回到未来》）的 堡垒之夜 来说，《起义》也是一部令人好奇的联动电影。
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/02/tu-endcard-16x9-1788375561239.png
这部时代剧——它可能（或可能不再）是一部罗宾汉起源电影——记录了 1381 年的农民起义，由历史人物瓦特·泰勒（由《幕府将军》的柯斯莫·贾维斯饰演）和约翰·鲍尔（由杰米·贝尔饰演）领导。安德鲁·加菲尔德饰演的主角普劳曼（Ploughman）代表了被不幸推向反抗王室武装道路的普通农民。
根据官方公告，“这项由 Sawhorse Productions 开发并由 Genesis Studios 发布的免费 Unreal Editor for 堡垒之夜 (UEFN) 体验，让玩家沉浸在传奇起义的核心，通过一场受《起义》事件和视觉景观启发的大规模多人战斗，将电影世界带入现实。”
“背景设定在 14 世纪 80 年代的英格兰，这项自定义的 5v5 运送目标体验让反叛军与皇家守卫在伦敦城门展开对决。反叛军必须推动冲车穿过四个不断升级的地图阶段，从泥泞的农田推进到坚固的城墙，而皇家守卫则要在时间耗尽前阻止他们的进攻。玩家将使用具有时代特色的近战武器和弓箭，赚取局内货币，并在战斗中策略性地升级生命值、速度和伤害。”
堡垒之夜 和 Focus 表示，《起义》体验“将以受电影启发的电影化结局告终，每种结果都有其独特之处，让玩家无论作为反叛军获得胜利，还是作为皇家守卫成功保卫王国，都能揭开《起义》故事的另一层面纱。”

items.title: “我们注重即兴发挥”：《Avengers: Doomsday》导演回应无剧本开机争议

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/PXBPhObubrypela.jpg
《Avengers: Doomsday》导演乔·罗素和安东尼·罗素为他们在剧本未完稿的情况下拍摄这部即将上映的漫威大作进行了辩护，并表示在拍摄现场仍会对电影进行进一步调整。
虽然这并非首部在制作期间不断进化的 MCU 电影，但《Avengers: Doomsday》无疑是漫威迄今为止最具挑战性的项目之一。它需要平衡庞大的角色阵容，满足极高的期待，而且在经历了一系列表现平平的前作后，克里斯·埃文斯和小罗伯特·唐尼的回归更像是一种“应急补救”的举措。
有传言称《Avengers: Doomsday》错综复杂的剧情碎片是在拍摄现场即兴拼凑的，这自然引起了部分粉丝的担忧，罗素兄弟现在正试图针对这一疑虑做出回应。
据美联社报道，乔·罗素表示：“我们始终将剧本视为一个‘生命体’。我们是基于即兴发挥和排练的导演。我们喜欢看演员为角色带来了什么，有时直到拍摄前几天或几周你才能见到演员。而很多时候，奇迹就在那时发生。”
考虑到有这么多角色参与其中，观察哪组演员在片场最有化学反应是有意义的，而且并没有迹象表明电影的主要情节基调没有提前敲定。在这里，罗素兄弟似乎更多是在谈论片场自然产生的特定台词或角色时刻。
尽管距离《Avengers: Doomsday》上映仅剩三个多月，罗素兄弟仍在对电影进行修补。据了解，目前正在进行进一步的补拍，涉及新增和回归的卡司成员（“鹰眼”演员杰瑞米·雷纳曾暗示他参与其中），这些工作被附加到了即将开始的明年《Avengers: Secret Wars》的制作周期中。

items.title: DC反派6部电影限定铁盒合集发布，支持夜光效果

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/KhLWjmbubrymjFu.png
过去五十年来最优秀的一些 DC 超级英雄电影现已收录在一个全新的 4K 铁盒收藏套装中。这套名为“DC反派6部电影限量合集 (DC Villains 6-Film collection)”的套装，收录了由超人、蝙蝠侠、海王等主演的电影。或许更贴切地说，这些电影中还有小丑、猫女、谜语人和莱克斯·卢瑟等反派角色。
该合集目前在亚马逊开启独家预售，售价为 139.99 美元，发售日期为 10 月 27 日。
DC反派6部电影限量版铁盒收藏套装 (4K UHD)
收录的电影跨度很大，从 1979 年克里斯托弗·里夫主演的经典之作《超人》到马特·里夫斯 2022 年的杰作《蝙蝠侠》。这些电影都非常出色，中间的四部也是如此，包括蒂姆·波顿执导的两部《蝙蝠侠》电影。请参阅下方的完整收录列表。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/siXpncbubrynmpu.jpg
虽然电影本身显然是这里的核心——包括英雄们对抗的标志性反派——但包装也是该合集的一个关键组成部分。六部电影中的每一部都有专属的铁盒包装，封面印有电影海报。如果你将这些铁盒放在灯光下照射，然后关掉灯，你会看到每个铁盒上都涂满了夜光涂鸦。这是一个非常酷的设计。
这六个铁盒都存放在一个收纳盒中，为每张光盘提供了充足的空间和保护。收纳盒本身也装饰有夜光标记。你可以从上面的照片中了解到它的外观。
合集中收录的电影
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/kVYyezbubrynnBr.jpg
根据评论界的共识，多年来 DC 电影在质量上一直参差不齐。然而，这里收录的所有电影都是公认的佳作。这个合集非常用心地跳过了像《蝙蝠侠与罗宾》、《猫女》和 2016 版《自杀小队》这样的败笔。合集中的作品水平都在“优秀”到“杰作”之间。总而言之，如果你不想要纯粹只有蝙蝠侠电影，这是一个非常扎实的 4K 合集。
似乎每家实体电影发行商都在努力抢在假日购物季之前发布新品。你可以预订包含全部 24 部宝可梦电影的精灵球合集，以及《变形金刚：大电影》的 40 周年纪念版，还有 15 部吉卜力工作室蓝光铁盒的再版。你可以在我们的未来 4K 蓝光发布日期列表中找到所有即将开启预售的电影。

items.title: 《Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2》阶段性评测

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/wAXJBhbubryllww.jpg

也许没有哪部电影比《异形》更适合改编成电子游戏了。一群带着枪的陆战队员对抗成群的恐怖野兽？宝贝，这就是电子游戏。对于第一部 Aliens: Fireteam Elite 来说确实如此，虽然我很喜欢那款游戏，但并没有玩太久；而对于它的续作 Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 也是如此，续作通过增加一名玩家和新职业等内容，为回归的架构注入了新鲜感。我还没通关 Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2（我想这是前往科隆游戏展跨国旅行的“乐趣”吧），但我玩得已经足够多了，可以开始整理思绪了，就像我的小队成员正在冲向目标，而我的文字则是掩护火力。简而言之：我和朋友们玩得很开心，但我很好奇在演职员表滚动之后，我们还会想玩多久。

你不需要熟悉前作也能理解这里发生了什么：奋进号（USS Endeavor）收到了来自 LV-558 殖民地一名看起来病得很重的皮尔斯博士（Dr. Pearce）发来的传输信号，那是维兰德-尤塔尼（Weyland-Yutani）公司的一个采矿殖民地，现在已被异形占领。陆战队派出了精英小队“女妖火线小队”（Fireteam Banshee）去控制局面，但他们都失踪了。你的陆战队员被调往奋进号，负责把他们带回家并弄清楚到底发生了什么。
我们对 Aliens: Fireteam Elite (2021) 的评价

Aliens: Fireteam Elite 做的正确之处足以让三位合作射击游戏爱好者觉得物有所值，他们宁愿与成群的异形作战，也不愿面对常见的僵尸。凭借出色的武器、职业、敌人类型以及对系列前作的一些精彩致敬，如果你对这个系列有任何喜爱，它都是必玩之作。当然，缺点是必须忍受重复的场景和一些极其漫长的任务。Aliens: Fireteam Elite 可能不是一次伟大的胜利，但远非“游戏结束，伙计”。 - 2021年8月23日
评分：7

第一部游戏在剧情上并不出众，Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 也没有在剧情上拖泥带水。在任务之间，你会在奋进号上闲逛并与你的小队聊天。这里有奋进号的指挥官希普（Shipp）；你那强悍、务实的小队领袖高（Ko）；派珀（Piper），一名刚接触实地工作、因此有点紧张的分析师；埃丝特（Esther），飞船上的仿生人；猛禽（Raptor），你的运输机飞行员，笑话讲得很烂（我是说真的很烂）；还有扳手（Wrench），你的机械师/武器专家/店主，他会分享一些超酷的鸟类知识。
我很喜欢这群船员，即使你只能在那些非常“盯着他们的脸听他们说话”的场景中与他们进行上半身的互动。我唯一的顾虑是，因为他们在任务中大多只是你耳边的声音，所以没有太多的战友情空间——而当有空间时，每个人都……太友好了？《异形》最精彩的部分之一就是角色之间并不总是和睦相处，虽然我觉得高吐槽猛禽（还有你）很棒，但我希望这些角色能更多地互相调侃。这能增加趣味，你懂的。
任务本身是该类型的标准套路。

与前作一样，Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 是一款以职业为基础、专注于合作的射击游戏。（你可以单人游玩，但你将与“字母男孩”组队：名为 Alpha、Beta 和 Gamma 的 CPU 控制的仿生人。）有六个职业可供选择，其中许多职业都有对应的《异形》电影原型。决斗者（Duelist）是希克斯；掠夺者（Marauder）是瓦斯奎兹；医疗兵（Medic）是迪特里希；以此类推。我最喜欢的是全新的专家（Specialist），它允许你结合多个职业的特点。比如，你想要机械师（Machinist）的特殊能力（他们的炮塔和漂浮护卫无人机），但也喜欢掠夺者的智能机枪（这是我早期的心头好）。那么，专家职业就能让你实现这一点。这太酷了。这并不是说坚持传统职业没有好处；它们拥有只有通过提升该职业等级才能获得的修正符和特殊能力。但如果你想进行一些微调，专家就是你的最佳选择。
任务本身是该类型的标准套路，但很有趣。空降到维兰德-尤塔尼的噩梦中，寻找情报/破坏东西/完成其他目标，杀死一些怪物，坚守直到撤离，然后撤离。这是一个有趣的循环，尤其是和朋友一起玩时，它与同类游戏的不同之处在于异形的种类繁多。

奔跑者（Runners）很快就会倒下，所以可能不值得在它们身上浪费任何花哨的消耗品（如手榴弹、地雷或特殊弹药）——但它们成群结队且速度极快，所以你很快就会应接不暇。喷吐者（Spitters）喜欢躲在后面从远处喷射酸液。然后是大家伙：战士（Warriors），它们会把你抓起来并试图用内口咬你；打了就跑的潜行者（Drones），它们从阴影中跃出并在火力下撤退；被称为徘徊者（Prowlers）的大型红色异形会扑向你，等等。在管理有限资源的同时找到应对一切的正确方案非常有意思，Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 在重大时刻绝不吝啬于向你倾泻所有敌人。
如果这还不够，某些任务还要求你对付维兰德-尤塔尼的合成人。这些敌人需要更具策略性的“寻找掩护、小心接近”的战术，而异形则会让你为了保命而奔跑。这是一个很好的节奏变化。
Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 在重大时刻绝不吝啬于向你倾泻所有敌人。
除了获得电影中使用的 M41A1 脉冲步枪（你开始使用的是较新型号）及其发出的声音所带来的愉悦感外，我最喜欢的是贴纸。你看，你可以自定义你的护甲，这已经很酷了，但你还可以添加可以移动、旋转和缩放的贴纸。我喜欢贴在脉冲步枪上的运输机贴纸，以及拍在胸甲上的心跳监测仪贴纸，但我仍在寻找瓦斯奎兹的“Adios”，因为我想把它贴在我的智能机枪上。感觉很对味，你懂吗？
到目前为止，我非常享受在 Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 中的时光，即使它并没有重新发明轮子。最好是和三个朋友一起玩（现在小队规模是四名陆战队员，多于原作的三名，所以你平时的小队成员都可以一起玩，而不会让一个人永远感到遗憾），但单人游玩也足够扎实。让我彻底查清维兰德-尤塔尼这一系列令人震惊的糟糕决定，之后我会给出一个评分。不过到目前为止，我可以确认，这确实是一场“虫子狩猎”。

日本商业杂志《选择》（Sentaku）最近报道称，Square Enix 正在考虑私有化，这导致该公司在东京证券交易所的股价上涨了近 12%。但 Square Enix 在回应这一说法时表示，事实并非如此。
“《选择》月刊 9 月号刊登了关于 Square Enix Holdings Co., LTD.（下称‘公司’）可能私有化的报道。然而，该信息并非由公司发布，”Square Enix 在一份声明中表示。“公司内部目前没有考虑将公司私有化。”

这一消息传出之际，整个游戏行业正处于更广泛的整合之中。EA 最近被一家沙特阿拉伯投资集团收购并私有化，这引起了粉丝和 EA 员工对新东家未来举措的担忧。他们是会继续投资 BioWare 的单人游戏，并利用 死亡空间：重制版 等备受喜爱的 IP，还是会加大对微交易和实时服务类游戏的投入？要真正看到收购和 EA 私有化决定的影响还需要一段时间，但很自然地，关于 Square Enix 的此类报道会引发对该公司未来的各种猜测。
死亡空间：重制版
恐怖, 科幻, 动作, 单人, 重制, 太空, 冒险, 生存, 第三人称射击
如果你对去年平淡无奇的《木卫四协议》感到失望，那么《死亡空间》重制版能让你重新找回激动的感觉，并适时提醒你这个老牌系列的出色程度。无论你是没有玩过原作的新人还是资深老鸟，都有充分的理由回归本作。

2013 年，Christiansen 在其线上作品集中发布了大量艺术图，其中一些展示了各种迪士尼角色对战的草图。这引发了人们的猜测，即迪士尼可能曾考虑过开发一款大乱斗格斗游戏——而 Christiansen 现在证实了这一点。
在接受采访时，Christiansen 透露了 王国之心2.8：终章高清版 如何出人意料地帮助这一构思成形，尽管它最终未能实现。事实上，王国之心2.8：终章高清版 最初很难获得批准，因为迪士尼高层对将旗下一些最具标志性的 IP 进行联动感到犹豫。
“王国之心2.8：终章高清版 难以起步的原因之一是迪士尼非常不情愿让《狮子王》的角色进入《小美人鱼》的世界，”他解释道，“这是迪士尼美国总部的核心障碍，他们无法接受这一点。所以，当时可能存在一些分歧，但最终都解决了。不过，所有的创意人员——比如我、其他艺术家和制作人——都认为这是世界上最棒的主意。就像，‘没错，让我们把所有东西都联动起来吧。’”
“由于 王国之心2.8：终章高清版 已经打破了这种模式，制作人们会说：‘嘿，如果我们说他们是动作人偶，采用类似《玩具总动员》的设定，但让他们互相战斗呢？’ 这样我们就可以拥有来自《泰山》、《狮子王》和 迪士尼的宝藏星球：沦陷者之战 的迪士尼角色动作人偶，做成类似 Smash Brothers 那样的游戏。该概念的标题是 Disney's Action Figure Face Off。”

遗憾的是，这款游戏从未问世；据报道，该项目仅达到了原型阶段，随后迪士尼便放弃了这一想法，转而开发电影和电视节目的联动游戏。

考虑到这一点，Christiansen 作品集中分享的概念图让我们对这款从未实现的游戏感到更加惋惜。艺术图展示了八个不同角色之间的 1v1 战斗：虎克船长对阵野兽、诺丁汉警长对阵路易王、乌苏拉对阵约翰·西尔弗，以及红心皇后对阵大角王。其中一些角色选角非常冷门（我们从未想过现今能在任何迪士尼大作中看到大角王，更不用说诺丁汉警长了），这让我们不禁好奇，如果这款游戏在现代真正制作出来，哪些角色会被选中。
“通常我们在向迪士尼提案时，他们想要的是那种贴满艺术图的巨大展示板。你会准备这些长六到八英尺、高约四英尺、厚一英寸的泡沫芯板，上面印着带有大 Logo 的艺术作品。这是一种极具视觉冲击力的方式，方便向高管们演示游戏。这促成了一些最终面世的作品，比如 Disney's Extreme Skate Adventure，”他继续说道。

“在迪士尼工作的四年里，我参与了许多从未实现的构思，”Christiansen 说，“我认为如果有电影或电视节目作为支撑，我可能会把它做下去，比如 迪士尼的宝藏星球：沦陷者之战、Atlantis、Peter Pan 2 或 麻辣女孩：猴子的复仇——这些游戏能获得资金——或者是皮克斯的作品，比如 Buzz Lightyear 和 怪物公司。但当时关于‘我们该如何处理手头这些 IP？’有非常多的讨论。所以有很多最终未能面世的概念作品。”
提到迪士尼与游戏，在今年的 D23 活动上展示了 王国之心2.8：终章高清版 IV 的加长版实机演示预告片，展示了来自《寻梦环游记》的亡灵之地以及现代城市 Quadratum 的近景。KHIV 预计于 2027 年底推出，导演野村哲也表示史克威尔艾尼克斯（Square Enix）已确定了这一发布窗口。

items.title: 在《We Were Here Tomorrow》中探索 Norček Industries 内等待着的秘密

content.v: 摘要
对于合作游戏爱好者来说，一场全新的冒险即将来临。在《We Were Here Tomorrow》的最新预告片中，我们向玩家展示了游戏在 10 月登陆 XBOX Series X|S 时所包含的一些奇异场景和非对称解谜内容。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/njqLbzbubrwzadz.jpg
我是 Total Mayhem Games 的创意总监 Martín Mittner。我很自豪能通过《We Were Here Tomorrow》将该系列带入未知的领域，同时保持其核心的合作游戏体验。
救援任务的突发变故
在《We Were Here Tomorrow》的开头，你和你的搭档正在冰封的南极景观中搜寻失踪的探险队成员。但在寒冷的环境中发生意外后，你们的救援任务发生了意想不到的转变。
你们在陌生的地方醒来：一个由 Norček Industries 运营的复古未来主义研究设施。在那里，你们见到了 Kathleen Bowe 总监，这位从科学家转型为管理者的负责人，负责监督该设施及其宏大的研究计划。
Bowe 总监看起来正是你想要寻求帮助的对象。她充满魅力、自信，并且似乎很乐意帮助你们弄清楚所处的陌生环境。然而，在那平易近人的外表之下，事情显然没那么简单。随着你们对 Norček Industries 的探索深入，想要判断 Bowe 是否在说实话变得越来越困难。
Norček 正在研究的东西可能会对世界产生巨大的影响。一个神秘的跨维度裂缝已成为他们工作的核心，而你和你的搭档很快发现，你们在理解这一现象中扮演着越来越重要的角色。裂缝背后究竟有什么？为什么 Norček 对它如此感兴趣？这些问题我们希望由你们亲自去发现。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/aBtyXLbubrwzbxC.jpg
透过不同镜头观察熟悉的领域
新预告片中展示的第一个区域是温室。对于《We Were Here》系列的资深玩家来说，这个空间可能会感到熟悉。在该区域中隐藏着许多对前作冒险中的地点、物体甚至植物的致敬。
但这里有一个转折。
两位玩家并非“处于”同一时间段体验这个空间。在过去采取的行动会对未来的玩家产生后果。再加上时间交换的能力，玩家被迫仔细描述他们所看到的一切，并思考超越自身周围环境的因果关系。
对讲机是玩家对比各自世界并尝试理解彼此行动如何关联的关键工具。这一切都关乎信息共享、共同实验，并逐渐揭示你们各自的经历是如何联系在一起的。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/klGyuObubrwzdff.jpg
埃舍尔（Escher）也会引以为傲
并非《We Were Here Tomorrow》中的每一个挑战都会将玩家完全隔开。
在设施的另一个部分，我们称之为“明日办公室”，你们会发现自己穿梭在重力和建筑规则看似不合常理的空间中。在这里，我们更注重移动和实验，要求你们在共享空间中移动时，创造性地思考如何使用手中的工具。
这类房间让我们有机会在保持《We Were Here》合作核心不变的前提下，进一步升级游戏公式。你们依然需要依赖搭档，但现在你们可能是在共同导航和试验，而不是仅仅描述两个完全独立空间里的事物。
看得见却够不着
当然，交流解谜仍然是游戏体验的核心。
在光学实验室里，你和你的搭档可以看到彼此，但实际上并不在同一个空间。这个谜题基于更传统的《We Were Here》设计风格：你们双方都能接触到不同的信息，需要清晰地沟通，以了解对方需要什么，从而设置正确的激光折射序列。
作为资深解谜设计师，我们明白“近距离”和“部分可见”并不等同于难度降低。你可能清楚地看到搭档在哪里以及在做什么，但这并不能让解法变得更简单。在某些方面，这反而为彼此间的误解创造了全新的机会。
光学实验室是第一章中难度较高的谜题之一，挑战玩家仔细调查周围环境、清晰分享信息并协同工作以取得进展。正如《We Were Here》一贯的风格，交流与行动同样重要。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/kvnhxhbubrwzety.jpg
超越你的认知
在冒险的后期，世界变得更加奇异。
Norček 研究核心的裂缝是围绕该设施谜团的重要组成部分，穿过它的门槛会将你们带到一个与你们所知的世界完全不同的地方。关于“裂缝之外”，我们暂时不会透露太多，因为我们希望这个区域能给人一种真正踏入未知领域的真实感。谁知道你在那里会发现什么呢？
你们共同创造的冒险
归根结底，《We Were Here Tomorrow》的核心在于人际关系。
我们可以构建奇异的世界、复杂的谜题和神秘的故事，但我们无法创造发生在两名玩家之间的瞬间。那些瞬间属于你们。比如当你的搭档终于让你理解了他们试图解释五分钟的内容时，那种从困惑到清晰的转变；那种自信地说出“一定是这样”，紧接着却遭遇失败的时刻；以及最终成功时带来的欢笑、释然与庆祝。
随着你们深入 Norček 的设施，你们将逐渐揭开关于 Bowe 总监、研究背后的公司以及影响周围世界的奇异事件的真相。但想要到达终点，需要的不仅仅是找到下一个开关或解开下一个谜题。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/uYttKzbubrwzgtD.jpg
你们需要倾听、描述所见、创造性地思考，最重要的是——沟通。
《We Were Here Tomorrow》将于今年 10 月登陆 XBOX Series X|S。现在就将其加入愿望清单，准备好去发现等待着你和搭档的“明日”吧。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/JYgtXfbubrwzjpd.jpg

content.v: 在最新一期的 Xbox 官方播客中，我们回到了 Blizzard 园区，为大家带来关于 BlizzCon 2026 的全方位前瞻！无论你是计划亲临阿纳海姆会议中心现场，还是准备在家中通过线上直播参与，这场将于 9 月 12 日至 13 日回归的盛会都将为你带来前所未有的体验。
访谈实录
（播客内容涉及全年龄段至成人级游戏）
LINA MADRID： 大家好，欢迎收看 Xbox 官方播客，我是 Lina。今天我们不在雷德蒙德的录音室，而是来到了加州尔湾的 Blizzard 园区。我非常激动，因为我们将深入了解 BlizzCon 2026 的精彩细节，今天做客的嘉宾是 Blizzard 全球活动高级总监 Kiersten Crissman。Kiersten，你好！
KIERSTEN CRISSMAN： 你好，Lina，我很好，你呢？
LINA MADRID： 我简直太兴奋了，我超爱 Blizzard，刚才还在到处合影。我们要聊聊你们刚发布的日程表，尤其是 9 月 13 日周日上午 11:45，大家在竞技场广场集合，正午时分吹响海螺。这是真的吗？
KIERSTEN CRISSMAN： 没错，那是“鱼人行军”（March of the Murlocs）环节，今年已经是第五届了。这已成为我们社区最受喜爱的传统之一。届时预计会有 4000 名粉丝装扮成可爱的鱼人参与，今年的官方颜色是翡翠绿。
LINA MADRID： 自从今年早些时候的 Blizzard 展示会发布了一系列重磅消息后，粉丝们就一直很期待。BlizzCon 线下盛会回归，为什么现在是合适的时机？
KIERSTEN CRISSMAN： BlizzCon 是我们最重要的活动，一切为了社区。今年是一个特殊的年份，从 Blizzard 本身到 暗黑破坏岛、Overwatch 和 Battle.net，我们都在庆祝历史性的里程碑，我们迫不及待想与大家共同庆祝。
LINA MADRID： 对于第一次参加或者老玩家来说，BlizzCon 的核心是什么？
KIERSTEN CRISSMAN： 最重要的是将整个 Blizzard 社区凝聚在一起。除了重大公告、游戏试玩和展区体验，这里更是玩家与游戏好友、公会成员线下相聚的时刻。即便现场有 37,000 人，你依然能感受到那种亲密的联系。
LINA MADRID： 2023 年我参加过，那种沉浸感令人惊叹，比如萨格拉斯之剑、酒馆和暗月马戏团。今年会有什么变化？
KIERSTEN CRISSMAN： 我们保留了所有经典项目。主舞台将迁回阿纳海姆会议中心最大的 D 厅，拥有超过 7500 个座位。暗月马戏团（Darkmoon Faire）规模也将比 2023 年更大，占地超过 7 万平方英尺，甚至增加了可以钓鱼的鸭子池。炉石传说 酒馆也会回归，并加入更多惊喜。
LINA MADRID： 线上观看的玩家体验如何？
KIERSTEN CRISSMAN： 我们发布了全新的“观众指南”。所有内容均免费，无需门票，大家可以在 YouTube 和 Twitch 上的 Warcraft、暗黑破坏岛 和 Overwatch 频道收看，总计超过 117 小时的节目。而且，观看直播还有机会获得游戏内奖励（掉宝）！
LINA MADRID： 聊聊电竞吧，Overwatch 世界杯回归了吗？

KIERSTEN CRISSMAN： 是的！Overwatch 将重返竞技场，这是庆祝世界杯的最佳地点。此外，小小魔兽 的竞技场世界锦标赛（AWC）和史诗地下城国际锦标赛（MDI）、炉石传说 大师巡回赛世界冠军赛也将回归。我们还首次举办了“Classic Cup”，由 Tasteless 和 Artosis 担任队长，汇集了如 BoxeR 和 Nal_rA 等传奇选手，总奖金池超过 120 万美元。
LINA MADRID： 还有什么粉丝绝对不能错过的？
KIERSTEN CRISSMAN： 暗黑破坏岛 的“Hell’s Ink”纹身活动将回归。此外，Blizzard Arcade 将重现经典，带来 星际争霸、红色管弦乐队2:斯大林格勒英雄 风起云涌 以及 Blizzard Arcade Collection 的怀旧体验。现场设有超过 1300 个游戏试玩台，我们还展示了 35 年来 Blizzard 的珍贵档案馆藏品。
LINA MADRID： 谢谢你，Kiersten！最后提醒大家，BlizzCon 将于 9 月 12 日至 13 日举行，无法亲临现场的朋友记得锁定线上直播。感谢大家的收听，我们下期 Xbox 官方播客再见！

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/pOgnAububrseigE.jpg
Xbox 发布了一系列与 8BitDo、SteelSeries 和 KontrolFreek 合作推出的官方授权配件。“Cozy Collection”（温馨系列）包括手柄、键盘、鼠标、耳机和摇杆帽的新配色，所有产品均兼容 Xbox 主机和 PC。
虽然每个外设的具体设计各不相同，但该系列通过柔和的绿色和棕色调、像素艺术风格以及整体的“自然”氛围实现了视觉统一。大多数配件现已发售，唯独 8BitDo Ultimate 3 手柄目前处于预售阶段，预计将于 9 月 29 日正式发布。
Cozy Collection - 兼容 Xbox 与 PC
该系列包含了 8BitDo 当前一代外设、SteelSeries 耳机以及 KontrolFreek 摇杆帽的新配色。系列中的每一件产品都是为 Xbox 和 PC 玩家量身定制的。
这些基础型号本身就备受好评。以 8BitDo 复古机械键盘为例，它是一款坚固耐用、制造精良的游戏键盘，手感与观感同样出色，并且具备易于编程的宏功能。
全新的“森林奇观”（Forest Wonder）配色在这些清脆的按键上装饰了各种生物和植物，其中 WASD 键上还印有极具 星露谷物语 风格的农作物。它还配备了出色的 RGB 背光，旨在呈现出“萤火虫穿过深夜寂静森林”的视觉效果。

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/vQRpkfbubrrobax.jpg

《由愤怒幽灵构成的幽灵手臂》（A Ghost Arm Made of Angry Ghosts）绝对是 2026 年最奇特且最难以描述的新漫画之一。它既是一部超级英雄系列作品，又带有朋克摇滚风格的生活片段，同时也致敬了经典的 Vertigo Comics 时代。或许 Matthew Rosenberg 在推荐语中描述得最为贴切：“《由愤怒幽灵构成的幽灵手臂》就像是 Daniel Clowes 和 David Lapham 联手尝试创作《X战警》，但他们其实并不怎么在乎是否拯救了世界。”
如果这听起来符合你的口味，那么你一定想看看我们独家提供的《由愤怒幽灵构成的幽灵手臂》第 1 期的预览。在下方的幻灯片图库中查看更多内容：
《由愤怒幽灵构成的幽灵手臂》由 Oliver Mertz（代表作《The Monuments》、《First Law of Mad Science》）编写并上色，Alex Diotto（代表作《Youth》、《Indigo Children》）绘制。该系列由 Oni Press 出版。以下是官方剧情简介：

少年 Ari Ackerman 沉迷于华盛顿特区的朋克场景，并正努力应对他患癌父亲不断临近的死亡（以及频繁的复活）。Ari 的好朋友 Maya Meng 只想在 Black Cat 俱乐部闲逛，看 Jawbox 乐队的演出。但遗憾的是，接连发生的离奇死亡事件真的会毁掉完美的一天……《由愤怒幽灵构成的幽灵手臂》充满了奇思妙想、冷幽默和风格创新，定能引起那些局外人、努力理解世界并寻找自己位置的人们的共鸣。
“我成长于 90 年代，经常去华盛顿特区周边那些狭窄的场馆看 Fugazi、Jawbox 和 Monorchid 等乐队的演出，”Mertz 在一份声明中说。“当我开始创作《由愤怒幽灵构成的幽灵手臂》时，我就知道我想把它写成一封给那个时代和地点的情书。但随着创作的深入，这本书变得越来越古怪。讽刺的是，它变得越奇怪，故事就越具有个人色彩且情感真实。”
“自从 Oliver 向我介绍了《幽灵手臂》中的角色后，我立刻与他们产生了强烈的联系，”Diotto 说。“我发现 Ari、Maya、Sona 和我自己之间有很多相似之处——即都是局外人，而且都是朋克乐队的老粉丝——随着我们工作的推进，这种联系变得更加紧密，书的内容也变得更加古怪。看到一碗汤通过嘴说话，或者一个巨大的头住在小屋里，可不是每天都能见到的！”
《由愤怒幽灵构成的幽灵手臂》第 1 期现已在商店发售。你可以在当地的漫画店订购。

在 2026 年科隆游戏展上，极限竞速：地平线5 的开发工作室展示了在阿尔比恩首都鲍尔斯顿进行的任务实机演示，其中的玩家英雄是一位我们从未见过的女性。这是对网络舆论的回应，还是仅仅展示了 神鬼寓言4 角色创建器所能提供的多样性？我询问了游戏总监 Ralph Fulton。

HBO 发布了 Harry Potter and The Philosopher’s Stone 的新预告片，这是该剧首季（共八集）的第二支预告片。该系列剧集将于 2026 年圣诞节在 HBO 首播，并同步上线 HBO Max 流媒体平台。

预告片展示了许多高光瞬间：一年级新生哈利·波特（Dominic McLaughlin 饰）戴上分院帽并被选入格兰芬多学院；哈利、赫敏·格兰杰（Arabella Stanton 饰）与罗恩·韦斯莱（Alastair Stout 饰）之间友谊的开端；一场魁地奇比赛；罗恩收到霍格沃茨录取通知书以及韦斯莱一家的更多镜头；魔药课教授西弗勒斯·斯内普（Paapa Essiedu 饰）对哈利印象平平；哈利使用隐形衣；厄里斯魔镜；男厕所里的巨怪；以及由 John Lithgow 饰演的阿不思·邓布利多、Janet McTeer 饰演的米勒娃·麦格和 Nick Frost 饰演的鲁伯·海格出现的多个画面。
此外，还有一些快速闪过的镜头，似乎是哈利的父母莉莉和詹姆·波特跑过大桥的回忆画面，以及我们可能首次见到的伏地魔形象。

Harry Potter and The Philosopher’s Stone 的演员阵容包括：Rory Wilmot 饰演纳威·隆巴顿、Lox Pratt 饰演德拉科·马尔福、Leo Earley 饰演西莫·斐尼甘、Elijah Oshin 饰演迪安·托马斯、Tristan Harland 饰演弗雷德·韦斯莱、Gabriel Harland 饰演乔治·韦斯莱、Ruari Spooner 饰演珀西·韦斯莱、Alessia Leoni 饰演帕瓦蒂·佩蒂尔、Sienna Moosah 饰演拉文德·布朗、Finn Stephens 饰演文森特·克拉布、William Nash 饰演格雷戈里·高尔、Warwick Davis 饰演菲利乌斯·弗立维以及 Sirine Saba 饰演波莫娜·斯普劳特。

其他演员还包括：Daniel Rigby 饰演弗农·德思礼、Bel Powley 饰演佩妮·德思礼、Paul Whitehouse 饰演阿格斯·费尔奇、Johnny Flynn 饰演卢修斯·马尔福、Bertie Carvel 饰演康奈利·福吉、Luke Thallon 饰演奎里纳斯·奇洛、Katherine Parkinson 饰演莫丽·韦斯莱、Amos Kitson 饰演达力·德思礼、Gracie Cochrane 饰演金妮·韦斯莱、Richard Durden 饰演宾斯教授、Louise Brealey 饰演罗兰达·霍琦、Bríd Brennan 饰演波比·庞弗雷、Leigh Gill 饰演拉环以及 Anton Lesser 饰演加里克·奥利凡德。

content.v: 每周三，欢迎来到 Indie Select Hub——这里是你获取最新精选独立游戏及每周轮换的四大主题推荐的门户！你可以在 Xbox 商店和 XBOX.com/IndieSelects 找到这个专题中心。
烧烤季接近尾声，开学季即将到来，天气也在悄然转凉。你知道这意味着什么：是时候进行一次季节性焕新了。所以，在你挑选新行头之前，让我们先确保你的游戏库里也加入了一些大胆的独立游戏原创佳作。我们的选品思路是：在经典基石之上，融入一些全新的创意。
本季度，ID@Xbox 团队精心挑选了六款 Indie Selects 游戏，它们通过令人难忘的世界观、充满创意的机制和独特的视角，重塑了大家熟悉的类型。每一款游戏都带来了独特的设定，无论是管理超级英雄、驾驶魔法卡车、在噩梦中求生、建设王国，还是投身于大规模战争。以下是本月为您带来的游戏（排名不分先后）：
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/UYjyWnbubrpBDEa.jpg
超英派遣中心
超英派遣中心
动作, 冒险, 休闲, 策略
查看更多 立即下载
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/NIVaJdbubrpCbcn.jpg
超英派遣中心
AdHoc Studio
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/WwBwwAbubrpCdji.jpg

当一位超级英雄失去了让他变得“超级”的能力后，会发生什么？显然，他只能去坐办公室了。 超英派遣中心 颠覆了传统的超级英雄套路。你将扮演罗伯特·罗伯逊（Robert Robertson），也就是人们熟知的“机甲侠”（Mecha Man）。在失去机甲战衣后，罗伯特加入了“超级英雄调度网络”，他不再亲自去拯救世界，而是负责派遣他人去执行任务。问题在于？他的团队大多由试图改邪归正的前超级反派组成，而且他们是一群极度不靠谱的家伙。

从核心来看， 超英派遣中心 是一部包裹在超级英雄冒险外壳下的职场喜剧。剧本绝对是它最大的亮点之一，在幽默风趣的瞬间与关于身份、失败、人际关系和第二次机会的故事之间取得了极佳的平衡。但你不仅仅是旁观者，随着洛杉矶各地出现紧急情况，你需要决定派遣哪位英雄前往。每位队员都有不同的优势和能力，这让每一次调度都成为一个小型的战略决策。有时你最想要的英雄无法出勤，迫使你不得不临时起意——甚至还得祈祷自己没有把事情搞得更糟。这些时刻让 超英派遣中心 在众多叙事冒险游戏中脱颖而出。你的团队不仅仅是一群供你观看的角色，而是你需要负责管理的对象。不久之后，我发现自己真的开始在乎他们了。游戏的动画表现进一步加深了这种联系， 超英派遣中心 玩起来就像是在体验一部成人向的超级英雄动画剧集，且配音阵容极其豪华，包括 Aaron Paul、Laura Bailey、Jeffrey Wright 和 Matthew Mercer 等人。
最让我惊喜的是，在所有混乱之下隐藏的温情。罗伯特的故事提出了一个意想不到的深刻问题：当你用来定义自己的事物消失时，没有了它，你又是谁？为了超级英雄、令人质疑的管理决策和职场混乱而来，却会因为这群古怪的团队开始带给你如家人般的归属感而留下。 超英派遣中心 证明了，你不需要披上斗篷也能成为英雄。
– Steven Allen
Truck-kun Is Supporting Me From Another World?!
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/cwLsskbubrpChkn.jpg
Truck-kun is Supporting Me from Another World?!
Frosty Pop
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/jYVCXobubrpCjiw.jpg
有没有想过为什么 Truck-kun is Supporting me from Another World?! 的开发商 Strange Scaffold 要叫“Strange（奇怪）”？这个词可以指未知、独特、夸张或超凡脱俗，这些词恰好涵盖了这款游戏。
哦等等，还要加上“乐趣”。一种荒诞、狂乱的乐趣。
又是老套路，对吧？卡车司机撞倒了上班族（Carissa），她随即被异世界 Talinfold 的精灵少女附身。你需要驾驶卡车摧毁沿途的一切人事物来增强精灵的力量，但别忘了你还要完成日常的送货任务。如果 Carissa 能击败骷髅王，她就能开启回家的传送门。很简单，对吧？
在这款充满重玩价值的沙盒游戏中，你将与时间赛跑，尽可能积累更多的分数。你需要制造最大程度的混乱，因为你撞到的每一个人都会在 Talinfold 召唤出怪物，供精灵 Carissa 击杀以获取经验值。撞击物体可以为她的剑充能，这样 Carissa 最终才能回到工作岗位！
但这远不止于此。这是一款融合了跳圈、得分、物理破坏的英雄游戏，在这里，彻底的毁灭就是美好的一天。它同样尖锐、刻薄且荒谬，幽默感贯穿了角色和游戏玩法。
等等，还有一个自由漫游模式？探索城市，被警察大喊大叫地追赶，摧毁水泥搅拌机和热狗摊，这不就是我们热爱驾驶的所有原因吗？或者可能只是我这么觉得（驾驶操控手感极佳确实加分不少）。
即使是在任务模式下，这款游戏也相当宽容。并不是说它很容易，但它太有趣了，以至于我乐于继续完成送货任务并出色地完成工作。别去想什么逻辑或后果，那太可笑了。出发吧，把工作干完。计时开始！
– John Sherwood
CULTIC
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/fdsplvbubrpClom.jpg
CULTIC
Atari, Infogrames, 3D Realms
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/jVETczbubrpCnre.jpg
这才是我想说的。 CULTIC 具备了一款优秀复古 FPS 的所有特质：爆炸性的动作、激烈的交火以及浓郁的生存恐怖氛围。但仅仅称它为“boomer shooter”有些低估了它的内涵。在体验了几个小时后，我感觉 CULTIC 不仅仅是受到了经典作品的启发——它正在以一种新鲜、现代且令人兴奋的方式重构这些经典。
叙事在 CULTIC 中处于次要地位。前提很简单：你死而复生，现在的任务就是消灭一个邪教及其召唤的恐怖生物。从表面上看，这听起来很熟悉，尤其是对于 Nightdive Studio 的 Blood: Fresh Supply 的粉丝来说。两款游戏都热爱阴暗的环境和狂热的敌人，但 CULTIC 通过精心的玩法设计和有效的恐怖氛围构建，迅速展现了自己的特色。

自然地， CULTIC 希望你在混乱中奔跑、滑铲、跳跃，并利用不断增加的破坏性武器库将邪教徒化为血雾。从斧头、手枪到步枪和炸药，每一件武器的使用反馈都非常令人满足。然而，最让我印象深刻的是它如何在不丢失灵魂的情况下实现了复古 FPS 公式现代化。武器提供了独特的玩法，成长反馈令人欣慰，战斗也几乎不会让人感到乏味。即使面对如潮水般的敌人，BOSS 战也会通过极具挑战性的战斗将紧张感推向高潮，需要你全神贯注应对。
CULTIC 真正闪光的地方在于它对恐怖元素的处理。环境令人深感不安，专注的关卡设计在爆发性的动作之间创造了一种持续的恐惧感。这种节奏带来了许多令人神经紧绷的时刻。我就不剧透细节了，但在仅靠一个打火机照明的情况下探索漆黑的矿井……对我来说，那真是太恐怖了。
CULTIC 今年在我们平台上赢得了最佳现代“boomer shooter”的一席之地，它将快节奏的暴力美学与有效的恐怖氛围完美融合。对于复古 FPS 动作和生存恐怖游戏的粉丝来说，这是一个不容错过的推荐。
– Raymond Estrada
Duskfade
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/WgNUPwbubrpCqFf.jpg
Duskfade
Fireshine Games
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/FQiQfJbubrpCsxs.jpg

随着 小龙斯派罗：重燃三部曲 的即将回归，3D 平台跳跃游戏再次受到关注似乎非常合时宜。我曾在 90 年代末到 2010 年代中期沉浸于该类型游戏（从 Crash 到 狡狐大冒险4：岁月神偷 等），但此后，整个类别似乎在大家的游戏列表中悄然退位——这种消失更像是一声叹息而非一次震撼。正因如此，当 Duskfade 出现在商店页面时，它给人的感觉更像是老友重逢，而不是什么突兀的异类。而它的玩法也确实如此。

你将踏上 Zirian 的旅程。他刚刚失去了祖父——一位镇上备受尊敬的钟表匠，他的妹妹也为了逃避悲伤而埋头于一项秘密计划。然而，妹妹的计划失控并占领了城市，不仅开启了通往敌对生物的门户，将郊区变成了异星领域，还意外地带来了一只毒舌的机械布谷鸟。从那时起，你需要穿梭于危险的景观中，收集大量摆放巧妙的货币，并通过击打、躲避和格挡来应对敌人。你将解锁升级、拜访商人，并慢慢清除镇上周围被危险侵蚀的各个区域。
对于那些在 3D 平台跳跃游戏中长大的人来说，这里并没有什么令人脑洞大开的创新，但真正突出的是开发团队对该类型游戏那种极其真诚、热忱的爱。从 Zirian 的操控手感到每一个物体或区域的视觉细节和色彩……你绝对能看出这个团队是多么热爱制作这款游戏。这种热爱非常有感染力，体现在每一场 BOSS 战中，也体现在引导你前往秘密洞穴或宝箱的宝石路径布局中。
The King Is Watching
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/qRDULSbubrpCvrw.jpg
The King is Watching
tinyBuild
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/HaMncMbubrpCydB.jpg
即时战略游戏有时会让人望而生畏。许多该类型的核心作品抛给玩家太多的系统和机制，很容易让人感到不知所措，尤其是对于像我这样的休闲玩家来说。我在 The King Is Watching 的最初几个小时就是这种感觉：不知所措。每一个决定都感觉至关重要，我总是担心自己把资源投错了地方。事实证明，优先级排序不仅是游戏的一部分，它就是游戏本身。
你的目标很简单：保卫你的王国，抵御接连不断的敌人浪潮。转折点在于，建筑只有在你主动关注它们时才会运作。在游戏初期，你只能专注于旋转的、类似 Tetris 网格中的三个空间，这迫使你在什么值得关注的问题上做出艰难的选择。我是想去收获庄稼，还是建造弓箭手，亦或是挖掘黄金来生成魔法咒语？为什么我把水井放在了市场旁边？每一次放置都至关重要，每一个错误都可能付出惨痛代价。
压力很大，我的第一次尝试以灾难告终。谢天谢地，这正是 Roguelite 元素闪光的地方。下一次尝试感觉截然不同，鼓励我从头开始重新思考策略。随着我解锁了永久升级、新的国王和强大的顾问，每一轮游戏都变得更加可控，我也对未来的战役更有信心。只要你愿意花时间去学习游戏中所有的机制，这种感觉是非常满足的。
The King Is Watching 是一款深度且要求极高的 RTS，上手曲线陡峭。在其多样的国王名单、可解锁的建筑和单位以及广泛的成长系统中，有大量的内容需要学习和掌握。其 Roguelite 进度系统（包括五个升级树和顾问加成）让每一次失败的尝试都具有持久的价值。如果你喜欢具有挑战性的策略游戏，并且不介意走出自己的舒适区，这很可能成为你的下一个心头好。
– Raymond Estrada

items.title: 时隔十年，Pokémon Go 将迎来宝可梦动画联动集

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260903/DGuGgcbubrnEsCu.png
Pokémon Go 的世界将于本月晚些时候与《宝可梦》动画系列联动。在这一集中，主角团将遇到维罗博士并转动宝可梦补给站（PokéStop）。
Pokémon Go 在今年夏天庆祝了其 10 周年，庆祝活动将在本月继续。作为里程碑式的《宝可梦：地平线》剧集将于 9 月 18 日在日本首播，届时将有几位非常特别的嘉宾登场。
是的，维罗博士本人将迎来他的动画首秀，他从在 Pokémon Go 中协助玩家的角色跨界而来。随他一起出现的还有他的搭档宝可梦美录坦，以及至少一个宝可梦补给站（PokéStop）——这是 Pokémon Go 玩家在游戏中转动的现实世界地点标识。
9月18日（星期五）18时55分起，确定播出 Pokémon Go 与动画宝可梦的联动剧集！ Pokémon Go 游戏内也将举办电视动画联动活动。 联动PV已公开，请查看！ #アニポケ #ポケモンGO
在官方日本宝可梦社交账号今天发布的预告片中，可以看到船长皮卡丘上方正在转动宝可梦补给站（PokéStop），并准确地获得了精灵球和树果作为奖励。此外，片中还揭示了一只一直躲在显眼处的变隐龙——这是对这种像变色龙一样的生物在 Pokémon Go 中抓捕方式的巧妙致敬。
维罗博士将如何与罗伊、莉可及系列中其他角色相遇仍有待观察，因为 Pokémon Go 与宝可梦系列其他作品的正统性关联一直不明朗。事实上，最初在 Pokémon Go 中登场的美录坦和美录梅塔缺少官方的起源地区（如城都或关都），而是被列为在“不明”地点发现。
无论如何，《宝可梦：地平线》与 Pokémon Go 也将在 Pokémon Go 游戏内进行联动。剧中佩戴护目镜的喷火龙将在 Pokémon Go 中开放捕捉，船长皮卡丘也将回归。所有这些活动都将在 9 月 16 日至 22 日期间举行，大约是特别篇在日本首播的时间。在美国，粉丝们可以通过 Netflix 开始观看《宝可梦：地平线》第三季，而在英国，该系列将在 BBC iPlayer 上首播。

鼠人（Skaven）虽然是战锤设定中最独特且最受欢迎的派系之一，但很少能在战锤游戏中担任主角。通常情况下，他们只是你在 战锤：末日鼠疫2 这种割草游戏中成群结队砍杀的炮灰。因此， Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster 立即脱颖而出，让你扮演机敏的鼠辈维尼克（Vihneek）。我们初次见到他时，他正被毫不客气地扔进一个充满腐烂尸体的深坑。显然，这大概不是他计划度过的一天。但在逆境中，他迅速继承了背刺血脉的潜行与谋杀天赋，穿梭于阴暗且充斥着害虫的2D横版卷轴环境中。即使在这段简短的试玩中，游戏也展示了丰富的挑战。

动作, 冒险, 射击, 砍杀, 血腥, 黑暗奇幻
实话实说，《战锤：末世*2》并不是什么大制作，它确实好玩，但是它不具备比拟3A大作的实力，它本身就是个中小游戏，它很好的表现出了一个中小游戏应有的素质和水平。游戏比起第一部来进步很大，但它的上限确确实实被成本限制了，最多算是《求生之路》系列的首席弟子，离继承衣钵还有一段距离。

鼠版骑士

维尼克最初的生存环境血腥、腐臭且几乎令人绝望。也就是说，对于一款以鼠人为主角的游戏来说，这简直完美。层层叠叠的洞穴向背景延伸，每一个缝隙和撕裂的帆布都涂抹着阴郁的恶意。我不是《凡世诸域》（Age of Sigmar）背景设定的资深专家，但作为拥有《战锤幻想》背景的玩家，我未必能一眼看出这是不同的设定。鼠人依然是那种极具辨识度的、充满欺诈荣耀的鼠人，做着鼠人该做的事：在由许多经常互相敌对的氏族统治的地下世界中潜行和策划阴谋。
起初我几乎毫无还手之力，脏兮兮的小爪子被锁在木枷里，只能缓慢地向两侧挪动。但在通过一些“敲击式”手段脱困后，我发现维尼克是一个动作敏捷的小淘气，在各种平台跳跃挑战中操控感非常出色。值得注意的是，你可以沿着大多数墙壁和天花板奔跑，这立即体现了扮演鼠人的精髓，使移动感与类似的横版游戏大不相同。赋予这一切生命的动画效果也十分到位。维尼克就是个古怪的小家伙，我很支持他。
我发现维尼克是一个动作敏捷的小淘气，在各种平台跳跃挑战中操控感非常出色。
在这次潜行逃脱后的初期阶段，机动性和潜行是我仅有的工具。目前还不清楚我是如何来到这里的，但向四面八方延伸的扭曲角落似乎是某种监狱。与任何武装守卫近距离接触都意味着瞬间死亡，并从当前房间的入口处重来，如果这些狱卒发现你，他们还能投掷极其精准的投掷物将你从高处击落。
躲在帘幕后、熄灭灯火以及投掷废弃的头骨作为诱饵，是避开他们的多种方法之一。维尼克还拥有实用的“本能视觉”模式，按住L2即可激活。该模式会让他固定在原地，但能看到敌人的视线范围和可交互对象，例如可以利用起重机将箱子砸在敌人头上。右摇杆还可以向任何方向移动视野，包括上下移动，这在我寻找下一个落脚点或出口时非常有帮助。
峰回路转
关卡设计在奖励探索以及引导玩家思考如何通过特定房间方面，让我想起了 空洞骑士：丝之歌 。在尝试逃脱时，维尼克可以寻找珍贵的次元石（Warpstone）——这是一种让鼠人痴迷的魔法资源（没错，真的是这样），正是它促使鼠人进化成智慧类人生物，并为他们的许多技术提供动力。这是可选任务，但它能为你提供额外的技能点，稍后详述。

最终，我找到了一块盾牌，可以在紧急情况下砸碎守卫的脑袋，这改变了游戏流程。我不再只能潜行和躲藏，而是可以绕到普通敌人身后，只需点击一下按键就能以残暴的方式处决他们。不过，奔跑甚至从高处落下都会发出声音，所以我仍需小心行事。
此外，当我被一只鼠人巨魔追赶时，我那破烂的尖锐木头毫无用处，最终被一只神秘的、手部长着刀刃的白色鼠辈救下，他没给我太多选择，只能加入他的氏族。
这时事情变得更有趣了。维尼克被吸纳为夜奔者（Night Runner），这相当于鼠人世界中的精锐忍者刺客。这份工作带来了一套酷炫的新装束，更重要的是，一套全新的能力。其中第一项是立即解锁的抓钩，它允许我飞跃到之前无法到达的各个位置。其余能力则需用次元石购买，包括从消音脚步到部署烟雾弹等各种技能。遗憾的是，在试玩期间我无法返回氏族藏身处购买这些技能。
疾行斩击
到了这一步， Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster 开始让人感觉到一种力量幻想。你依然很脆弱，但我感觉到自己已经变成了掠食者，而其他人现在都是猎物。好吧，也许那只鼠人巨魔除外。每个区域都变成了一个谜题，我扫描环境陷阱、干扰物和隐藏点，以确定可以偷袭哪些守卫，以及按什么顺序攻击才不会惊动他们的同伙。
平台跳跃本身并不特别困难，至少目前是这样，但对地下世界的仔细观察往往能带来次元石奖励。游戏的精髓在于缓慢而彻底的推进，而非复杂的技巧执行，尽管在某些房间里我必须迅速执行计划以防被守卫抓住。
潜行游戏的支柱元素与 空洞骑士：丝之歌 式平台跳跃的结合非常顺畅。
然而，故事仍然有点模糊。我不确定维尼克为什么像腐烂垃圾一样被扔进坑里。我们不知道为什么他的尾巴后半段被焊接了一个发光的奇怪肢体，也不知道为什么他的氏族同伴嘲笑地称他为“半鼠”。到目前为止，所有的暴力行为都属于鼠人内部的自相残杀。这非常符合设定——在这个宇宙中，鼠辈潮（战锤：末日鼠疫2）之所以还没有席卷世界，主要原因就是大角鼠的子民们花在互相算计和残杀上的时间，和他们对付其他种族的时间一样多。
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/01/wh-deathmaster-screen-02-1788297803546.png

我的第一个任务是摧毁敌对氏族的啃咬洞（Gnawhole），这本质上是一条通往世界更深处的通道，他们可以利用它召唤援军。然而，在我到达那里之前，这短短30分钟的试玩就结束了。我们确实看到了一些非上手的演示，包括一场与致命暴风鼠（Stormvermin）的Boss战，维尼克需要利用环境——最终利用次元石驱动的闪电炮——才能赢得战斗。如果公平竞争，他只会被打残并被抛弃。毕竟，哪有正直的鼠人会公平竞争呢？
我非常享受这段简短的 Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster 体验。美术风格阴暗肮脏，但保持了极高的辨识度。潜行游戏的支柱元素与 空洞骑士：丝之歌 式平台跳跃的结合非常顺畅。在逐渐获得新能力的过程中，通过探索和背刺穿过那些棘手的区域，让游戏体验保持了新鲜感。从鼠人那双贼溜溜的小眼睛里观察凡世诸域，让一切都焕然一新。也许带点霉味，但确实很新鲜。
总的来说，我非常期待玩到更多内容。即使把试玩版玩了三遍，我对这种毛茸茸的混乱场面的渴望仍未得到满足。我们都将在2027年把 Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster 掌控在我们充满诡计的爪中。

items.title: Double Fine 著名的 Game Jam 带着 26 个新想法回归，并承诺如果实现其 Kickstarter 延伸目标，将制作《Brutal Legend 2》
items.summary: The Amnesia Fortnight Kickstarter blew past its goal in just two days, but getting a new Brutal Legend is goin

content.v: One happy upside to Double Fine's newly-regained independence is the return of Amnesia Fortnight , the semi-regular in-house game jam in which everyone stops what they're doing and spends two weeks pitching and developing prototypes for new games. The 2026 edition of the event—seemingly the first since Microsoft acquired Double Fine in 2019—launched a Kickstarter campaign on August 31, and its $400,000 goal has already been surpassed.

The Amnesia Fortnight crowdfunding campaign serves two purposes. It raises money for Double Fine, which is good, but it also grants power : Just like in a real democracy, people who are willing to spend money will get to sway the process in voting for which of the 26 game pitches actually get made, and the more you spend the more influence you have. At the $15 tier, for instance, your vote only counts for half, but at $30 you get a full vote—and if you go up to $60, your vote is doubled—a single vote cast counts for two! What a great system.

Voting will close on September 6, following the conclusion of PAX, after which the Amnesia Fortnight game jam actually begins: Over the following two weeks, the top four finalists will be built into playable demos, which will then be put out to the public for final voting.

The Kickstarter ends on September 30, after which the big winner will be revealed, and then polished and unleashed out into the world. If it's especially good, it might even be made into a "real game": Previous Double Fine games including Costume Quest , Iron Brigade , and Stacking , and the Compton's Cook-off level in Psychonauts 2, all began as Amnesia Fortnight prototypes.
There are some very cool pitches up on the Kickstarter—here are a few that caught my eye:

Fermi's Playground : Presented by Oliver Franzke. Enrico Fermi famously asked why, in a galaxy this old and this large, we've never heard from anyone. Fermi's Playground hands you the controls: tweak the laws of nature to shift the odds of habitable worlds, sprinkle in supernovae and meteor impacts, run the simulation, and see what a galaxy full of curious explorers would actually take.

Insolation : Presented by Derek Brand. Insolation is a survival game where you’ll pilot an agile spider-bot across a desolate landscape to find and protect the last few species of plants left on the planet. Traverse like a spider. Cling to surfaces, rappel on cables and swing across gaps while imposing machines patrol the space below.
Lucid Gardening : Presented by Matt Enright. In Lucid Gardening, you cultivate a supernatural garden of mysterious plants and animals.

Virtual Pet Manifesto : Presented by Merita Lundstrom Virtual Pet Manifesto is a social idle game where you and your friends are virtual pets. Take care of each other, hang out, and define your new regime, all from the comfort of your desktop.

Lesbian Sled Death: Presented By: Fiona Gallagher. Join the women's Rocket Sled Derby to impress your girl, in Lesbian Sled Death: a four-player, jet-powered, full-contact racing game, where you don't always win by finishing first. (I won't lie, the title is what first grabbed my attention, but the pitch is compelling.)

There are many more, 26 in total, so you'll want to check out the Kickstarter page if you're interested in throwing your weight behind any of them. Insolation is my pick of the litter—not that I have any great affinity for survival games, but I'm a sucker for 'sad lonely robot at the end of the world' stuff. Gets me every time.

As is the way with Kickstarter, there are also stretch goals—one stretch goal, to be precise: If the campaign earns $100 million, Double Fine will make Brütal Legend 2. "Yes, really." Is it going to happen? No, not really: Never say never and all that, but Shenmue 3 was (and as far as I know still is) the most-funded videogame project in Kickstarter history, and it finished with $6.3 million. So yeah, that's a big mountain to climb.
It's possible that other stretch goals are on the way, but Double Fine said "we'll have to wait and see."

items.title: CD Projekt Red 仍在大肆赚钱，等待《巫师 4》
items.summary: CD Projekt Red has released its latest earnings report for the first half of 2026, and in short, it was a bang

content.v: CD Projekt Red has released its latest earnings report for the first half of 2026, and in short, it was a banger of a period for the company, and things are only expected to improve with many big-name releases on the horizon.

For the January-July period, CD Projekt Red generated 435 million PLN ($116.4 million USD) in revenue, which was up 23% year-over-year. Additionally, the company posted a net profit of 249 million PLN ($66.6 million USD), which was up 37% year-over-year. Total net profitability for the company was a very impressive 57%.

Management said in its report that these strong results were driven in part by "strong sales" of The Witcher and Cyberpunk games. Additionally, CD Projekt said it benefitted nicely from licensing revenue, a category that is becoming more and more important to the company.

The company specifically called out licensing deals that Cyberpunk 2077 had with games like Wuthering Waves and Apex Legends this year. Additionally, the company pointed out how well Cyberpunk TCG did on Kickstarter.

It would appear that CD Projekt's revenues are only set to grow further in the time ahead. That's because the studio has a lot of big games and content on tap, including The Witcher 3 Remastered this year , The Witcher 3's Songs of the Past expansion in 2027 , and then The Witcher 4 in 2028 .

items.title: 《矮人要塞》联合创始人表示，他作为百万富翁的生活“基本上就像重新获得我父母通过正常工作所能做的事情”
items.summary: Tarn Adams lives in a house now. I bet that's nice.

content.v: Back in 2024, Dwarf Fortress surpassed 800,000 copies sold, more than enough to make co-creators Tarn and Zach Adams millionaires . At the time, they seemed to be taking a low-key approach to the whole mo' money thing, so when our intrepid interviewer Joshua Wolens caught up with Tarn at the recently-concluded Gamescom, he asked if, in the two years since then, he'd more fully adjusted to his moneybags lifestyle.

"I guess, a bit, somewhat. I mean, I live in a house now. I have two cats and they love me. That's great," Adams said. But, he added, it wasn't so much a matter of adjusting to something new as just going back to what used to be.
"I know what [having a house] is like because I grew up in one. It's basically like reattaining what my parents could do with regular jobs. It's not much different from that.
"And I don't want to make light of financial security, right? I mean, yeah, that's great, and I wish it for everybody."

It makes me think of Adams' comments in the same interview about enabling a more equitable, better-functioning society in Dwarf Fortress by walling up dwarf nobles and abolishing the dwarf cops: He said there's perhaps a " lesson to be had there ." Maybe there's a lesson to be had here, too.

Anyway, lest anyone worry about the impact Adams' growing wealth—Dwarf Fortress moved past one million copies sold in 2025—will have on the game's future, that too is moving ahead pretty much unchanged. "We're back to work," Adams said. "I mean, work is the same."

That work is presumably Dwarf Fortress' first Myth and Magic update , slated to go live later this year, which aims to bring magic to the game. And not just the occasional fireball or invisibility cloak: Adams said in August that the goal is to create "procedural magic systems that go beyond combining spell effects and go straight to the fundamental cosmological makeup of the universe." Sounds very Dwarf Fortress indeed.

items.summary: Prison Architect 2--a very highly anticipated sequel--was originally scheduled to launch way back in 2024. The

content.v: Prison Architect 2--a very highly anticipated sequel--was originally scheduled to launch way back in 2024. The game was delayed to September of that year before later being delayed indefinitely, but after more than two years of waiting, we finally have a sign that it could be approaching a new release date: another beta test.
Following a beta back in April--which was the first official update from Paradox on the game since it was delayed in 2024--Prison Architect 2 will hold another closed beta for September.

The sign-up sheet , which is now closed, asks a few different questions of potential testers. The most important is if they are willing to sign an NDA, so don't expect news to come out of the closed beta.
The actual playtest will run from September 9-15, but it's unclear if the closed beta will be followed by an open beta later down the line.

Back in August of 2024, Paradox said "we need more time to improve both the game's performance and its content," offering refunds to those who preorders and not committing to a new release date. The game hasn't been available to purchase since then, which could lead to people thinking it was canceled. Above, you can see a video of what the game looked like back then.

It's been well over a decade since the original Prison Architect released. In addition to PC, it's available on Xbox, PlayStation, and iOS. Prison Architect 2 is planned to launch for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S alongside PC.

items.summary: Welcome back, Impact Crater.

content.v: Back in June, Capcom revealed Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance , a "massive," Iceborne-style expansion promising new and returning monsters, new regions to hunt in, and—of course—new combat options. In the announcement trailer, Capcom offered a brief glimpse at the Boost Bracer, an enigmatic new mechanic that seemed to augment hunter fighting styles with additional jolts of combustion-fueled power.

Three months later, we're now getting our first real insight into how the Boost Bracer works and how we can expect it to alter the flow of hunting in Wilds. Earlier today, Capcom uploaded both a video overview of Boost Bracer mechanics and a great sword-focused boost action breakdown , with similar videos expected for each other weapon type.

Having watched both, I feel safe in saying Capcom's borrowing some pages from one of its other flashy action franchises: With the Boost Bracer, Ascendance has more than a little Devil May Cry in the mix.

The overview video sticks to the broadest possible strokes, but from what we can tell, early impressions of the Boost Bracer as being 'a thing on your arm that makes your attacks go crazy' seem right on the money.

The most basic component of Boost Bracer combat is the Boost Driver: a new kind of attack that each weapon type will have its own version of. Based on a gauge seen in the great sword video, Boost Drivers seem to operate on a charge system similar to the wirebug charges that powered switch skills in Monster Hunter Rise.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/V5XEXy7KHDTrcRQHyDc7YP.jpg

In fact, some of the Boost Drivers shown in the videos appear to be returning switch skills; as a hammer main, I'm extremely pleased to see Impact Crater making a reappearance. Unlike wirebugs, however, deploying a Boost Driver will temporarily enter the hunter into a new Boost state, which is—by all appearances—a sort of sicko mode for lizard swordfights.

As the videos explain, being boosted offers a number of benefits: Guarding will be more effective. Some weapon combos will be extended with dramatic new attacks, like an explosive final shot that bow users will be able to tag onto their power volley combos. Some existing attacks will be enhanced with greater impact: a boosted dual blade demon combo was augmented with echoing slashes after each attack, while the charge blade's elemental discharge produced… even more discharge. (Sorry.)

Capcom says "boost can also be activated during certain actions," with footage indicating that the boost state input can be woven on command into great sword charges, sword and shield plunging thrusts, gunlance guards, and likely many more maneuvers.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/7xDr65nobC73couGch3LXU.jpg

As a system for layering explosive, enhanced variations into combat—and a healthy dose of added visual flair—there are some undeniable shades of Devil May Cry in the Boost Bracer. It's not quite the Exceed system , but I think Nero would approve. Maybe? I don't know. The boy is troubled.

I'm withholding judgment until I can try the Boost Bracer for myself, but so far, I'm pleased with what I'm seeing. It seems like a bit more of an intuitive concept for adding over-the-top attacks than Rise's bug-powered ninja maneuvers, and it looks like less of a disruption to the moment-to-moment flow of MonHun combat than the Clutch Claw proved to be in Iceborne.

I just hope those boosted actions aren't too effective—if the combination of the Boost Bracer and Focus Mode trivializes Master Rank, it'll feel like a pretty major misfire. But something tells me an elder dragon will be making me regret those words by this time next year.
Monster Hunter Rise: Ascendance will launch sometime in 2027. You can wishlist it on Steam now.

items.title: YouTuber Claims Rockstar Confirmed Fans Measured Oxygen Levels Around Its Campus in Anticipation for a New Trailer
items.summary: Italian YouTuber Mike ShowSha got to visit Rockstar ahead of the company’s big GTA 6 Netflix showcase, where d

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/27/gta-6-jason-police-1787861023226.jpg

Italian YouTuber Mike ShowSha got to visit Rockstar ahead of the company’s big GTA 6 Netflix showcase, where developers told him that overeager fans were literally measuring the oxygen levels around their campus in anticipation for a new trailer.

Back in June, a GTA superfan went viral for supposedly measuring oxygen levels around the Rockstar North campus. Their thinking was that, if these levels increased, more staff were on site, meaning that the team was working especially hard or preparing for a big announcement.

This same fan had set up acoustic audio equipment outside the campus and even camped outside the area, monitoring traffic from incoming and outgoing employees in a desperate attempt to gauge the status of the game’s development process.

Update: He started monitoring oxygen around Rockstar North, and he believes Trailer 3 is coming soon after noticing that oxygen levels dropped to around 20.3% and 20.04% after 5 PM, suggesting increased oxygen consumption in the area after normal working hours. (Source:… https://t.co/nG5kOSTgkh pic.twitter.com/9XiN31cNLU

YouTuber Mike ShowSha was one of the lucky creators who got invited to Rockstar’s offices to see the game up close and personal before its extended look went live on Netflix — and he claims that employees confirmed this superfan really did measure the oxygen levels at their workplace.

“Guys, I’ve been told some weird things,” the YouTuber said in an August 28 video , via machine translation. “Like, there are people who measure oxygen levels — I don’t know how they do it, but they told me this at Rockstar, so I’d tend to believe them, because if there’s a sign that suggests there are more people inside the studios, it means development has increased, and therefore it’s about to happen. It's crazy.”
Responses to this anecdote have been equal parts hilarious and disturbed, with one joking on X, “No wonder they started the trailer with, ‘Yoo, Crackheads!’”
“That level of obsession over a trailer is wild,” another said .
“Bruh, who thinks like this?” another asked . “I mean, it's pretty smart, but think about what people would do if they really want something.”

Grand Theft Auto 6 finally launches on November 19, 2026, when it will officially put the ‘We got [XYZ] before GTA 6’ memes to rest. We got to see a good look at what we can expect from the extended Netflix showcase , as well as from our own visit to the Rockstar offices, where we learned 69 new details about the game — including the fact that you don’t have to actively engage with Jason and Lucia’s relationship mechanic if you don’t feel like it.

items.summary: Resident Evil games over the years have slowly added more fantastical elements to their tale of bioweapons run

content.v: Resident Evil games over the years have slowly added more fantastical elements to their tale of bioweapons running amok, but for the new live-action movie , director Zach Cregger is dialing back those ideas to a more "grounded" level. Even so, he doesn't think he'd fare very well if he were dropped in that world.
"I feel like some of the Resident Evil games get a little magical," Cregger said during a Reddit Ask Me Anything session (via YouTuber Troy Hill Talks Movies ).

"[Resident Evil] 8, we have a woman who can turn into a bird and fly around. And like, I love it. I've played it a bunch of times. I think it's an awesome game, but in terms of me making a movie out of it, it's like I've got to try and limit some of the wild aspects of Resident Evil. And so I chose to stick with the T-Virus, keep it as grounded as possible. So that means I'm not going to have a gigantic jacked dude in a trench coat, because I'm like, where'd the coat come from? How did he get the coat?"

Cregger explained that while the Resident Evil games do explain how Mr. X gets his stylish coat, in the world he has constructed for the movie, there's no time for the infected bioweapons to consider zombie apocalypse fashion. "This movie, it's like the outbreak just happened," Cregger added. "I want to keep it chaotic, I want to keep it primal, and I want to just keep it as grounded as I can. The T-Virus causes all kinds of cool, fun mutations. That is enough, so I'm limiting it there."

As a co-founder of the comedy troupe The Whitest Kids U' Know, Cregger says that the muscles he developed for creating sketch comedy also helped him zero in on "absurd" opportunities and find the right timing for unexpected results in Resident Evil. As for his chances of surviving his own creation? Cregger doesn't think he'd last too long in his version of Resident Evil.

"There's no chance I would survive," Cregger bluntly stated. "I wouldn't have survived the cop car attack because I would have probably just dropped to my knees and just been like, just bite me, just f***ing do it. I can't handle that kind of energy. No, I would die so fast."

Resident Evil will be out September 18 in theaters, and the movie is projected to have a big opening weekend in North America. For more on the film, you can also read up on how several of the best Resident Evil games inspired the visuals of the upcoming movie.

items.title: 《异形：火力小队 2》迄今为止评测
items.summary: Another glorious day in the corps.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/02/aliens-fireteam-elite-2-blogroll-1788369166031.jpg

Perhaps no movie was primed to be a video game more than Aliens. A bunch of marines with guns up against hordes of monstrous beasties? That’s a video game, baby. That was true for the first Aliens: Fireteam Elite, a game I enjoyed but didn’t stick with for too long, and it’s also true of its sequel, which freshens that returning structure up with things like an additional player and a new class. I’m not done with Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 yet (the joys of international travel to Gamescom, I reckon), but I’ve played enough to start laying down thoughts like one of my squadmates is spiriting for an objective and my words are covering fire. The short version is this: I’m having a good time with my friends, but I am curious how long we’ll want to play after the credits roll.

You don’t have to be familiar with the original to understand what’s up here: the USS Endeavor received a transmission from a very sick-looking woman named Dr. Pearce based on LV-558, a Weyland-Yutani mining colony overrun by Xenomorphs. The marines sent in Fireteam Banshee, an elite squad, to contain the situation. They’ve all gone missing. Your Marine has been transferred to the Endeavor to bring them home and figure out what the hell is going on.
What We Said About Aliens: Fireteam Elite (2021)

Aliens: Fireteam Elite does enough right to be plenty worthwhile for a trio of co-op shooter fans who’d rather battle hordes of xenomorphs than the usual zombies. Between the excellent weapons, classes, and enemy types and some wonderful nostalgic hat-tips toward what came before, it's a must-play if you hold any fondness for this series. The caveats, of course, are having to put up with repetitive scenarios and some excruciatingly drawn-out missions. Aliens: Fireteam Elite may not be a triumphant win, but it's far from a game over, man. - Kyle Campbell, August 23, 2021
Score: 7
Read the full Aliens: Fireteam Elite review .

The first game wasn’t huge on story, and it doesn’t bog down Fireteam Elite 2 either. Between missions, you’ll hang out on the Endeavor and chat with your squad. There’s Shipp, the Endeavor’s CO; Ko, your tough-as-nails, no-nonsense squad leader; Piper, an analyst who is new to boots-on-the-ground work and a little nervous as a result; Esther, the ship’s android; Raptor, your dropship pilot with terrible (and I do mean terrible ) jokes; and Wrench, your mechanic/weapons specialist/shopkeeper who dispenses rad bird facts.

I enjoy the crew, even if you only really interact with them from the waist up in very “look at their face while they talk to you” scenes. My only qualm is that, because they’re mostly just the voice in your ear on missions, there’s not much room for camaraderie – and when there is, everyone’s… too nice? One of the best parts of Aliens is that the characters don’t always get along, and while I think it’s great that Ko roasts Raptor (and you), I wish these characters razzed each other a bit more. It adds flavor, you know?

Like its predecessor, Aliens Fireteam Elite 2 is a class-based, co-op-focused shooter. (You can play it solo, but you’ll be teamed up with The Alphabet Boys: CPU-controlled androids named Alpha, Beta, and Gamma.) You’ve got six classes to choose from, many of which have their own Aliens analogue. Duelist is Hicks; Marauder is Vasquez; Medic is Dietrich (there’s a deep cut for you); and so on. My favorite was the all-new Specialist, which allows you to combine the features of multiple classes. Say, for instance, you want the special abilities of the Machinist (their turret and floating bodyguard drone) but also like the Marauder’s smartgun, which is one of my early favorites. Well, the Specialist will let you do that. It’s rad. That’s not to say there’s no benefit to sticking with the traditional classes; they have modifiers and special abilities that you’ll only get by leveling that class. But if you want to do some tweaking, Specialist is your guy (or gal).

The missions themselves are pretty standard fare for the genre, but they are fun. Drop into a Weyland-Yutani nightmare, hunt for intel/break stuff/complete other objectives, kill some monstrosities, hold out until you can get out, and then get out. It’s a fun loop, especially with friends, and is set apart from other games like it by how many different kinds of Xenomorphs there are.

Runners go down quickly, so they’re probably not worth spending anything fancy or consumable on (like grenades or mines or special ammo) – but they come in big groups and they’re fast little buggers, so you can get overwhelmed quickly. Spitters like to sit back and shoot acid from afar. Then you have the big dudes: the Warriors who will pick you up and try to get you with their second mouth; the hit-and-run Drones (think the Alien from the original Alien) who leap from the shadows and retreat from fire; large red Xenos called Prowlers that pounce on you, and so on. Figuring out the right answer for everything while managing your limited resources is a lot of fun, and Fireteam Elite 2 isn’t scared to throw everything at you in the big moments.

If that wasn’t enough, certain missions also ask you to deal with Wey-Yu synthetics. These require a more methodical “take cover, approach carefully” strategy, where the Xenos will just have you running for your lives. It’s a nice change of pace.

My favorite thing, aside from the happy brain chemicals released from acquiring the M41A1 Pulse Rifle used in the film (you start with a newer model) and the sound it makes, are decals. See, you can customize your armor, which is already cool, but you can also add decals that you can move, rotate, and resize. I like the dropship I’ve attached to my Pulse Rifle and the heartbeat monitor that I’ve slapped on my breastplate, but I’m still searching for Vasquez’s Adios because I want to slap it on my smartgun. Feels right, you know? So far, I’m quite enjoying my time with Fireteam Elite 2, even if it doesn’t reinvent the wheel. It’s best with three friends (the squad size is now four marines, up from the original’s three, so your usual squad can all play instead of one person being perpetually sad), but it’s solid enough solo. Let me get to the bottom of this round of Weyland-Yutani’s startlingly bad decisions, and I’ll have a score for you. So far, however, I can confirm that it is in fact a bug hunt.

items.summary: Ahead of the release of Resident Evil later this month, director Zach Cregger sat down for an Ask Me Anything

content.v: Ahead of the release of Resident Evil later this month, director Zach Cregger sat down for an Ask Me Anything session on Reddit he answered questions about the movie. While trailers for Resident Evil have teased a few Easter eggs that players of the game will recognize, Cregger also spoke about another game-inspired influence on his horror movie: Resident Evil's third-person viewpoint.
"I feel like the biggest inspiration for this was the games, and I mean cinematically," Cregger said during the AMA (via YouTuber Troy Hill Talks Movies ).

"I'm not talking about the content of the movie. I'm talking about the visual language of the movie. I feel like people my age and younger, we grew up with our visual tastes informed just as much by video games as we did by movies. I know as a kid, I played video games probably just as much as I watched movies. There's something that is ingrained now about this third-person camera and this first-person thing where you really are learning the space as the character learns the space, and you feel much more immersed in their perspective because you are. And so, for me to make a movie about Resident Evil where I'm following a character on his foot journey, it's like, obviously, I'm going to employ the visual vocabulary that these games have employed so well."

Cregger added that he choreographed scenes to emulate this gameplay approach, so as to "train the viewer" early on as to how they're going to experience the movie and the journey of Bryan, the medical courier played by Austin Abrams . Resident Evil 7 was also influential on the film for how it portrayed a normal person being put through the ringer, Cregger said, but Resident Evil 4 also played a large role in the "rhythm" of the film.

"[Resident Evil] 4 has the rhythm that I really like, where you're moving from set piece to set piece, location to location," Cregger explained. "Resident Evil 4 is just such a big game. You go through all these different worlds, from the village to the castle, and to the island. It just kind of keeps giving and giving. I like the idea of kind of borrowing the rhythm and the scale from RE4 and using some of the character elements from RE7."
Resident Evil hits theaters on September 18, and Cregger has teased a fast-paced movie full of "f**ked up and weird" imagery for fans to enjoy.

items.title: 我将 GTA 6 泄漏精确的汽车加油改装到了 GTA 5 中
items.summary: It's a sim now. I'm a sim now.

content.v: I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .

We saw many things during Grand Theft Auto 6's weird Netflix reveal , and it's official: GTA is simmy now. The gendarmes will meticulously document your physical appearance, and escaping them will necessitate changing it up. Jason and Lucia will also, the prophets tell us, feel the effects of sleeplessness and bad diet, just like mortals.

One thing we haven't seen from official sources: cars needing petrol . That particularly sim-ish feature has only been part of contraband GTA 6 leaks. Nevertheless, I have completely internalised this mechanic into my vision of the game. If you can't trust anonymous online weirdos trying to flog you some crypto thing, who can you trust?

So, naturally, I had to incorporate a working gas mechanic into my ongoing quest to turn GTA 5 into GTA 6 or kill it by trying. I installed Fumes – Animated Persistent Fuel , whose functions are thus: "Every vanilla and online vehicle carries a real fuel tank. It empties as you drive and it is still empty when you come back to that car tomorrow.

"Refuelling is not a menu," it says, casting subtle shade on all those non-hardcore car-gassing mechanics out there. "Get out, walk to the pump, take the nozzle off it—it goes in your hand and the hose comes with you on a real physics rope." Yes. All of these things are refuelling, to me.
It works like this: on your minimap, while driving, a new meter now tracks how much petrol your car's got left in it. Run out, and your journey's at an end. You know, like how cars work.

This was difficult to test. As we've already well-established, my current installation of GTA 5 is a nightmare merry-go-round of frictionless cars and increasingly contradictory mods. To actually acquire a car, I first had to figure out how to make one stop, and how to make sure it did not get immediately detonated by the hordes of hitmen and ambient gang violence that have become the burden of my Los Santos life. It's harder than it sounds: even throwing myself beneath a car's wheels didn't really help. Yes, the driver would get out to ask if I was okay (I was not), but the car would keep going.

I eventually commandeered one, however, by teleporting (Franklin can teleport now). The mod worked! Also, numerous other mods I already had installed kept throwing errors, which is probably fine. But amid the error messages and chaos, I managed to make it to a petrol station, in order to test the mod's robust in-person refuelling mechanics.

content.v: I don't like waging into gaming romance wars—things got a bit dicey with Ada and Claire—but it seems that I am yet to learn my lesson because here I am again with the news that Geralt's one true love isn't Yennifer or Triss, it's his trusty and talkative bard, Dandelion. At least Geralt's gaming voice actor Doug Cockle believes there's something special between the two.

During a chat with PC Gamer's Joshua Wolens at Gamescom last week (where he also saw Songs of the Past in action ) Geralt's voice actor Doug Cockle revealed that, yes, he thinks Dandelion may in fact be his character's better half, but there's a catch: "I would say yes, but in a very platonic way.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/shv2x9VnnY5L5FsPzPgK5M.jpg

Cockle says he doesn't want to liken their relationship to the cliche that is "bros over hoes" because "it's a horrible phrase" but there is a seed of truth to it in how Geralt prioritises Dandelion over some of the other characters in The Witcher 3 .
"I think there is a bit of that in Geralt's and Dandelion's relationship that you know," Cockle says. "Whenever Dandelion is in trouble, Geralt drops everything, and he's off to save him."

Just look to The Wild Hunt's first main quest in Act 1, Poet Under Pressure, in which Geralt has to track Dandelion down, kill the Witch Hunter, and free him as he's tied to a chair in a halflings' hut.

The quest that comes to mind here is Count Reuven's Treasure where Geralt has to ignore the sounds of Triss being tortured to get information on Dandelion's whereabouts. Although there are other reasons as to why this is the best decision, and Triss can certainly hold her own.

With all of this in mind Dandelion's voice actor John Schwab is eager to point out that just because Geralt is always around to aid Dandelion "that doesn't mean that Geralt is like 'Yay! It's saving Dandelion time again'." To which Cockle adds "yeah, it's 'awe he's in trouble again' you know". Imagine that said in a somewhat exasperated tone—it shouldn't be too hard to do so.

items.title: OpenAI 负责人 Sam Altman 表示“人们讨厌数据中心”，但该公司仍计划仅今年就在人工智能基础设施上投资 5000 万美元
items.summary: Putting two and two together, but coming up with a completely different answer.

content.v: Earlier this year, shots were fired and an incendiary device was thrown at the house of OpenAI CEO Sam Altman. In a recent interview with Time , he reflected on the past year: "It has been a painful personal experience. Clearly, people hate data centres—right now, at least. People are pretty negative on AI."

Does that mean OpenAI is packing it in, and going home? Well, no. The AI infrastructure buildout is continuing in earnest, with OpenAI planning to invest another $50 million this year alone on collecting compute. Sachin Katti, the co-lead on OpenAI's compute strategy told Time that the company's earlier investments now appear "very prescient," going on to add, "We are still short of compute. If anything, we should have bought a lot more."

If OpenAI's machine-learning products don't bring in the revenue the company would like, renting out its compute capacity to other parties is another option. Altman told Time, "I think we are going to be able to use all of the compute very profitably that we are planning to build."

Intent on investing millions more either way, it makes me wonder where the company will find the space to build—not just in terms of logistics, but also in terms of 'Who would want an AI data centre next door?' As we've previously covered, data centres don't always make great neighbours, with Wisconsin residents filing a class-action lawsuit against Microsoft earlier this year , alleging 'unreasonable and excessive noise'.

For another example from last year, Elon Musk's Colossus data centre was at the centre of an environmental row over air quality in South Memphis . The impact of data centres on nearby communities is by no means the only reason fuelling negative sentiments towards AI, but tangible knock-on effects like rising power costs are hard to ignore. There are also bigger picture environmental effects to consider, with one report suggesting gas power projects for just 11 US data centre projects could emit more greenhouse gases than entire countries .

The class of 2026 is arguably not looking forward to the world that may follow; an ex-Google CEO was loudly booed by a stadium full of students after talking about AI , while another university graduate speaker was booed for saying AI 'is the next industrial revolution .' As for games, one data analyst found that Steam games which disclosed the use of AI got 53% fewer reviews overall , and those they do get tend to generally be more negative too. Clearly, many people hate data centres—and I'd say that's for good reason too.

September is officially upon us, and while that means cooler weather is starting to blow in, it also means a fresh selection of PC games have dropped for the month courtesy of Humble Choice . This month's lineup features 8 games - including Frostpunk 2 , Sonic X Shadow Generations , and Voidtrain - which members can snag for their Steam library for just $14.99.

Compared to paying full price for each of these 8 games, this is a stellar offer to jump on. That's not the end of it, either. Those who sign up to become a Humble Choice member this month will also get a free month of IGN Plus , up to 20% off in the Humble store, and 5% of the membership cost goes to a charity.
We've detailed these bonuses, alongside the games included, below so you can learn a bit more.
Humble Choice - September 2026
Humble Choice September 2026 Game List

Whether you're looking for something cozy or more action-packed, September's lineup offers quite a nice variety to add to your PC library. There's a couple we think very highly of, too. Frostpunk 2 is one we really enjoyed, earning an 8/10 in our review of it, with writer Dan Stapleton noting that its "larger scale is less intimate but more socially and politically complex than the original."

Sonic X Shadow Generations is another pick from this month's selection that we're very big fans of. IGN's Jada Griffin, who stamped it with a 9/10 score in their review , praised that it " takes an already excellent game and spring jumps it to new heights at a blistering pace by doubling up the campaign length with creative level design, fantastic bosses, plenty of collectibles, and an appreciable graphical upgrade."

As mentioned earlier, though, the games aren't the only highlight of a Humble Choice membership. With the free month of IGN Plus, you'll get to enjoy some sweet bonuses across the site, such as being able to disable ads, and even score some free games.

There's also the discount of up to 20% off in the Humble Store, and the 5% of your membership that's sent to a charity each month. For September, that charity is Make-A-Wish , which helps to create wishes for kids with critical illnesses.
Of course, you can cancel anytime if you find this membership isn't a good fit. You're also able to skip a month, if a later drop doesn't catch your eye.

items.title: 如何观看 PlayStation 2026 年 9 月的游戏状况
items.summary: Sony announced two State of Play streams for September 3. Here's how you can watch the announcements live.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/01/playstation-1-blogroll-1788301648652.jpg

Should the plural of “State of Play” be States of Play or State of Plays? Either way, Sony is starting September with two back-to-back showcase streams — a State of Play and a State of Play Japan — on Thursday, September 3. These will be the second and third State of Play of the year following the one in early June , which gave us that bloody Wolverine opening (cool) and the first big look at God of War Laufey. In its August 31 blog post , Sony didn’t provide many specifics about what to expect outside of an “extended look” at Final Fantasy VII Revelation and the typical promise of "updates and announcements," but we have some ideas about what we'll see ( more on that below ).
IGN will be carrying the stream; here’s everything you need to know about how to watch, where to watch, and what you can expect from the double-header State of Play lineup.
When Does PlayStation’s September 2026 State of Play Start?

Sony will kick off the first State of Play on September 3 at 6am PT / 9am ET / 3pm CEST / 10pm JST. The company didn’t say how long that one will go (though they typically run for about 40 minutes), but the State of Play Japan, hosted by Yuki Kaji, will immediately follow. Both streams will be in English and Japanese (hosted in English with Japanese subtitles available for the first; hosted in Japanese and subtitled in English for the second).
We’ll be hosting a pre-show 15 minutes before the start of the first presentation at 5:45am PT / 8:45am ET / 2:45pm CEST / 9:45pm JST.
Once the Sony streams wrap, IGN will be live again for a Beyond post-show to discuss everything we just saw.
We’ll also be liveblogging these streams and covering everything that gets announced — stay tuned for all the news.
How to Watch the September 2026 PlayStation State of Play
IGN will be hosting State of Play streams right on IGN dot com, as well as all the classic social channels and our handy-dandy app. Here are all of those links:
What to Expect From the September 2026 PlayStation State of Play

A double stream! That’s fun. In its blog post, Sony teased the classic “updates and announcements from PlayStation Studios and our third-party partners” and will end on ”an extended look at the vast world of Final Fantasy VII Revelation.” (We also got a not-so-extended look at the game that highlighted the Weapons out of gamescom's Opening Night Live. )

What else? Well, maybe one last look at Marvel’s Wolverine before it comes out later this month, God of War Laufey, a Ghost of Yotei DLC, Kingdom Hearts 4, Control Resonant, Star Wars: Galactic Racer, Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, Resident Evil: Veronica… Would it finally be time to get another look at Naughty Dog's Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet? It was noticeably absent from June's SoP and it did just wrap performance capture .
You can read more on all of our inklings on what we might see from the State of Play streams . Of course, expect plenty of surprises.

Sony’s been in hot water lately with its insistent commitment to ending physical games by 2028 . You can surely expect the chat to be popping off with people having big feelings about it — that’s what happened during the Phantom Blade Zero stream in mid-August.
For more, check out what was revealed at last year’s September State of Play and this year’s Summer Games Fest back in June.
